meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲：Reuben Morgan / 4.5Music

lines.b: Hide me now under Your wings

lines.a: 遮蓋我 在祢大能手中
lines.b: Cover me within Your mighty hand
When the oceans rise and thunders roar
I will soar with You above the storm
Father You are King over the flood
I will be still and know You are God
I will be still and know You are God

lines.a: 我靈安息 在基督裡
lines.b: Find rest my soul in Christ alone

lines.a: 祢大能 使我安然信靠
lines.b: Know His power in quietness and trust

lines.a: 即使有風暴 要將我吞沒
lines.b: Even if swallowed by the rough seas

lines.a: 耶穌祢永遠 不放開祢的手
lines.b: Jesus's hands will never let me go

lines.a: 祢說不要怕 風浪中繼續 看著我
所以我剛強 在祢的愛中
憑信心勝過 直到看見突破
lines.b: I step forward by faith or I row by faith

lines.a: 因為我生命 這艘船是屬 主耶穌
